⚠ FBAR REQUIRED if aggregate max value of ALL foreign accounts > $10,000 at ANY point during the year

• Report ALL foreign accounts if aggregate max > $10,000 at ANY point
• Non-willful penalty: up to $16,536 per violation
• FBAR conversion corrected: all maximum balances use Treasury's 12/31/2025 rate of 5.477 BRL/USD

values: Track Brazilian taxes paid to offset U.S. tax liability
• File Form 1116 to claim Foreign Tax Credit
• FTC is almost always more beneficial than deducting foreign taxes on Schedule A
• Cannot claim both FTC and Schedule A deduction for same taxes
• Foreign property taxes (IPTU) deduction suspended since 2017 TCJA — check with CPA
• Enter Date Paid to use the preceding available Federal Reserve H.10 spot rate; if blank, the IRS 2025 yearly average or provisional 2026 YTD average is used.

values: Schedule E Summary — Foreign Rental Properties (2025)
Data flows here from Property 1, 2 & 3 sheets for Schedule E preparation
• Foreign property depreciation: 30 years (ADS), not 27.5 years
• All amounts must be in USD using IRS-accepted exchange rates
• Foreign property taxes (IPTU) — deduction suspended per TCJA 2017; verify with CPA
• Rental income NOT eligible for Foreign Earned Income Exclusion (FEIE)
• Must report even if operating at a loss
• Form 8938 (FATCA) if assets > $100,000 year-end (MFJ, living in US)
